Class JustificationModel

java.lang.Object
ca.mcscert.jpipe.model.JustificationModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
Justification, Template
public abstract sealed class JustificationModel extends Object permits Justification, Template
Abstract base for all named justification models. Sealed to exactly two subtypes: Justification (concrete) and Template (abstract/reusable).

Both kinds of model hold any JustificationElement: a Justification that implements a template holds the template's AbstractSupport placeholders until they are overridden. What a justification may declare is narrower, and enforced where elements are declared (Unit.addInto(String, JustificationElement)) and by the completeness check (no-abstract-support).

Every model has exactly one Conclusion, set via setConclusion(Conclusion) and accessed via conclusion(). Passing a Conclusion to addElement(JustificationElement) is rejected.

Use validate() to check consistency and completeness. For location-aware diagnostics in a compiler pipeline use ConsistencyValidator and CompletenessValidator directly.

    • recordAlias

      public void recordAlias(String oldId, String newId)
      Records that oldId was merged into newId within this model during composition/unification. Enables consumers of an exported model to reference a merged element by any of its pre-merge ids.

    • recordUnifiedId

      public void recordUnifiedId(String id)
      Records that id was minted by unification to stand for a group of merged elements, rather than written in a source file.

      Unification names a merged group after a counter (unified_0), so the id carries no meaning outside the compiler and cannot be traced back to anything the author wrote. Exporters that address an audience, such as the Python module a developer implements against, use this to name the element by the ids it was merged from instead. Contrast the elements a composition operator synthesises (assembleConclusion), which are genuine elements of the composed model carrying labels the author supplied in the operator call, and are not recorded here.

    • recordComposition

      public void recordComposition(Composition composition)
      Records the operator call this model was built by. The JPIPE export writes a composed model back as that call, since its ids, qualified by the models it was composed from, cannot be declared in a body.

    • inline

      public void inline(Template template, String templateName)
      Inlines template into this model: each template element is copied with a qualified id (templateName:originalId) and support edges between copied elements are re-wired. The model becomes self-contained — operators can mutate it freely without affecting the original template.

      Every template element is copied, AbstractSupport placeholders included, so that override commands can find and replace them in a Justification after inlining.

      The template's conclusion is always copied as a Conclusion, maintaining its top-level status. If this model already has a conclusion, the template's conclusion is mapped to it for edge re-wiring but not added as a second conclusion.

      The copies come before the elements this model already holds, so that its elements are in the same order whether its template is declared before or after it: a composition meets the elements of its sources in that order, and numbers the elements it unifies accordingly.

    • validate

      public List<Violation> validate()
      Validates this model for consistency and completeness without requiring a Unit. Useful for non-compiler consumers that build models programmatically.

      All violations carry SourceLocation.UNKNOWN because source location data is only available when building through the compiler pipeline (see ConsistencyValidator and CompletenessValidator).

      Returns:
      unmodifiable list of violations; empty means valid.

    • forEachSupportEdge

      public void forEachSupportEdge(BiConsumer<String,String> action)
      Calls action once per support edge of this model, passing the id of the supported element and then the id of its supporter. The conclusion's edge comes first, then those of the sub-conclusions, then those of the strategies, each in model order.

    • concreteOverrides

      public List<JustificationElement> concreteOverrides()
      Elements that replaced an ancestor's AbstractSupport placeholder — same qualified id, but a concrete type (e.g. Evidence or SubConclusion).

      Together with ownElements() and inheritedElements(), these three lists partition getElements().

    • isInheritedNonSupport

      public boolean isInheritedNonSupport(String id)
      Returns true when id names an ancestor-template element of any type other than an AbstractSupport placeholder (a strategy, conclusion, sub-conclusion, or evidence inherited from the template) — template-internal structure that a model implementing the template must not reference. A model may only override the template's @support placeholders, never reach inside its structure.

      Returns false for template @support ids (whether overridden or not) and for ids local to this model. The id must be the resolved (qualified) element id.

    • findById

      public Optional<JustificationElement> findById(String id)
      Searches both the conclusion field and the elements list, so callers do not need to know how the conclusion is stored.

      Command conditions call this on every pass of the execution engine, so it reads the fields directly rather than going through allElements(), which copies the model's elements.

    • ambiguousMatches

      public List<JustificationElement> ambiguousMatches(String id)
      The elements id names ambiguously: when no element has that id, the inherited ones it names through the short-name fallback of findById(String), if there are several; nothing otherwise. A caller that binds an id the source wrote reports these rather than settle on the first (ADR-0012, #177).

    • inheritedMatches

      public List<JustificationElement> inheritedMatches(String id)
      The inherited elements a plain id names through the short-name fallback of findById(String): every element, the inherited conclusion included, whose qualified id ends with :id. More than one is an ambiguity the caller must not settle by picking the first (ADR-0012).

    • qualifiedCopy

      protected static JustificationElement qualifiedCopy(JustificationElement elem, String prefix)
      Creates a copy of elem. If the element's id is already qualified (contains :), the id is preserved as-is — it was inherited from a grandparent template and must not be double-qualified. Plain ids are prefixed with prefix:.
